edits.text: If the user changes any details of the request in the same turn they provide confirmation, you must list the updated details and obtain a new explicit confirmation before calling `exchange_delivered_order_items`.
edits.reason: Ensures the agent does not proceed with outdated information when a user modifies details during the confirmation turn.

edits.text: When proposing a modification to a pending order, you must remind the customer to confirm they have provided all the items they want to modify.
edits.reason: Fulfills a specific reminder required by the policy's 'Modify items' section.

edits.text: When the user asks to switch a product to the cheapest available option, you must call `get_product_details` for that product type to find all available options before responding.
edits.reason: Corrects a failure to call the required tool to verify available options before making a claim about product availability.

edits.text: When the user asks for return logistics or shipping details, inform them that these details will be provided in the email they receive regarding how to return items.
edits.reason: Prevents unnecessary transfers to human agents by correctly referencing the policy's mechanism for providing logistics information.
